exposure: previous abdominopelvic surgery (tubal ligation, LSCS, appendicectomy)
cohort: 120 women diagnosed with ectopic pregnancy at a tertiary care hospital in Gaya, Bihar, India, between April 2019 and February 2022.
finding: The incidence of ectopic pregnancy was 0.029% (2.9 per 1000 antenatal visits up to 20 weeks), with the fallopian tube being the most common site (89.17%), and pelvic inflammatory disease the most common risk factor (45.83%).
